description: Read the signed-in account’s passive monitoring evidence at zero credit cost. Omit arguments for billing and verified target IDs. Pass target with evidence for the 30-day report or protection for canary and response IDs. For alert history use events and copy next into before with the same target filter. Use setup for collector requirements and vulkill_list_reports for scan reports.

before.description: For events only. Pass the previous page’s next value verbatim. Omit it for the latest events.

target.description: Verified target UUID from overview. Required for evidence and protection. Optional for overview and events. Omit for setup.

view.description: Default overview: account billing and verified targets, or feature status for one target. events: alert history. evidence: the target’s 30-day report. protection: canaries, badge and response status. setup: connection requirements.

name: vulkill_watchtower_read
title: Read Watchtower monitoring evidence
